name: The Knowledge Lifecycle of Large Language Models
description: A unified framework organizing large language model knowledge management into five stages, acquisition, storage, retrieval, update and forgetting, with two contributions: Lifecycle Desynchronization, a KL-based metric that quantifies the failure occurring when parametric weights and retrieved context conflict, measured reproducibly on GPT-2, and the Provenance Vector, an architectural proposal that gates stale parametric activations using acquisition metadata.
